quote: Mori proved the existence of flips in dimension three in 1988. This raised the natural question of whether infinite sequences of flips could occur in higher dimensions.
note: The problem arises naturally from Mori's 1988 proof of the flip theorem for 3-folds. The termination conjecture—that infinite sequences of flips cannot occur—was formulated in the context of the minimal model program following this foundational work.
